fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 这条街上有 24 扇门，其中 2/3 贴了新春联，有多少扇门贴了新春联？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: {name} starts riding through the hutongs at 4:10 and stops at 4:35. How many minutes did she ride?
questions.q_zh: {name} 4:10 开始骑车逛胡同，4:35 停下，骑了多少分钟？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 5 hutong gates each have 8 lanterns. How many lanterns in all?
questions.q_zh: 5 家门口每家挂 8 个灯笼，一共多少个灯笼？

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the bridge Flora sees a firework flash, then hears its bang a couple of seconds later. What causes the delay?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在桥上先看见烟花闪光，过两秒才听到响声。造成这段延迟的原因是什么？
choices: Sound travels much slower than light
Light needs time to warm up
questions.explain_en: Light arrives almost instantly; sound travels about 340 m/s.
questions.explain_zh: 光几乎瞬间到达，声音每秒只走约 340 米。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Fifteen days after Spring Festival, families walk on the bridge for the Lantern Festival. What does the moon usually look like that night?
questions.q_zh: 春节过后十五天，一家人到桥上过元宵节。那晚的月亮通常是什么样？
questions.explain_en: The 15th of a lunar month is near full moon.
questions.explain_zh: 农历十五前后是满月。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A red carpet for the bridge's lantern show is 12 m long and 11 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯会铺的红地毯长 12 米、宽 11 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the bridge, 7 lantern strings each hold 13 lanterns, and 7 big lanterns hang at the end. How many lanterns are on the bridge?
questions.q_zh: 桥上有 7 串灯笼，每串 13 个，桥头还挂着 7 个大灯笼，桥上一共多少个灯笼？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the bridge, 28 glow sticks are shared equally by 2 friends. How many does each friend get?
questions.q_zh: 在桥上，28 根荧光棒平均分给 2 个朋友，每人几根？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 42 lanterns hang on the bridge, and 5/6 of them are gold. How many lanterns are gold?
questions.q_zh: 桥上挂着 42 个灯笼，其中 5/6 是金色的，金灯笼有多少个？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of New Year sweets on the bridge is 14 cm × 9 cm × 25 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一个年货礼盒长 14 厘米、宽 9 厘米、高 25 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Near the bridge, Flora buys 4 lanterns at 9 yuan each and pays with 50 yuan. How much change does she get?
questions.q_zh: 在桥边，Flora 买了 4 个灯笼，每个 9 元，付了 50 元，应找回多少元？
